instruction.text: Read the two texts and compare them to answer the questions.

atoms.text:
Text One:
This is the first time Keegan and Brody have been sailing. They are having so much fun! They are helping their grandpa change the sails and learning how to tie different knots. Keegan likes to ask questions about how the sails work, and Brody likes the feel of the waves against the boat.

atoms.text:
Text Two:
Roberto thought he would love sailing. Turns out, his stomach hates it. He was so excited to be on the water for his first time sailing, soaking up the sun and enjoying the view of the water. Now, he is stuck sitting and trying really hard not to be sick. This is his first and last time sailing!
